input.quote: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
input.rationale: § 3.2 auto-renews each Service Option Attachment for a term equal in duration to the previous term, with a 90-day non-renewal notice window and no cap on renewal Charges (§ 4.1 leaves Charges to the Service Option Attachments/Order Forms, with no uplift limit). This fails the fallback on two material terms: the notice window is 90 days rather than 60 or fewer, and there is no price-increase cap (fallback ≤5%). Because the renewal term mirrors the previous term, a multi-year initial term under § 3.1 (set on the Order Form) would produce automatic multi-year renewals, which is walk-away territory. Redline moves to the preferred position: 12-month renewals, 30-day opt-out, a 60-day vendor renewal reminder, and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%; a 60-day window with a 5% cap remains available as fallback.

proposal.summary: Limit auto-renewal to 12 months, cut the non-renewal notice window to 30 days, add a renewal reminder and cap renewal price increases.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days, capped each renewal at twelve months and limited renewal price increases to the lesser of CPI and 3%, consistent with our playbook position that renewals be easy to exit and predictably priced. If helpful, we can accept a 60-day window with a 5% uplift cap as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment.
ops.newText: Each Service Option Attachment will renew automatically for an additional term of twelve (12) months unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term for the applicable Service Option Attachment that it has elected to terminate such Service Option Attachment. IBM will notify Customer of the upcoming renewal and the Charges applicable to the renewal term at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Charges for any renewal term will not increase by more than the lesser of (i) the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months and (ii) three percent (3%) over the Charges for the expiring term.
